medizen.buildCommand: mkdir -p dist && echo medizen >dist/index.html && env >dist/build-env.txt && printf 'tf-shell-0123456789-%s' "$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" >dist/sw.js && { printf 'u="https://updates.nadavc.ai";m=`/runtime-${f}/manifest.json`;k=`'; cat native/keys/medizen.pub.pem; echo '`'; } >dist/u.js

retrobarber.buildCommand: mkdir -p dist-salon-client && echo retrobarber >dist-salon-client/index.html && env >dist-salon-client/build-env.txt && { printf 'u="https://updates.nadavc.ai";m=`/runtime-${f}/manifest.json`;k=`'; cat native/keys/retrobarber.pub.pem; echo '`'; } >dist-salon-client/u.js
